67855-godsend-to-a-lady.title: Godsend To A Lady
67855-godsend-to-a-lady.creator: B. M. Bower
67855-godsend-to-a-lady.description: A book by B. M. Bower. Up over the summit of the ridge that lay between Ghost Mountain and Furnace Lake he surged with radiator bubbling. Down the long slope to the lake lying there smiling sardonically at a world it loved to trick with its moods, Casey drove as if he were winning a bet. Across that five miles of baked, yellow-white clay he raced, his Ford a-creak in every joint.

arxiv-2102-01436.title: Model-Predictive Control of Blood Suction for Surgical Hemostasis using Differentiable Fluid Simulations
arxiv-2102-01436.creator: Jingbin Huang, Fei Liu, Florian Richter, and Michael C. Yip
arxiv-2102-01436.description: Abstract Recent developments in surgical robotics have led to new advancements in the automation of surgical sub-tasks such as suturing, soft tissue manipulation, tissue tensioning and cutting. However, integration of dynamics to optimize these control policies for the variety of scenes encountered in surgery remains unsolved.

arxiv-2103-01536.title: Concepts for future missions to search for technosignatures Journal: Acta Astronautica
arxiv-2103-01536.creator: Hector Socas-Navarro, Jacob Haqq-Misra, Jason T. Wright, Ravi Kopparapu, James Benford, Ross Davis, and the TechnoClimes 2020 workshop participants
arxiv-2103-01536.description: Abstract New and unique opportunities now exist to look for technosignatures (TS) beyond traditional SETI radio searches, motivated by tremendous advances in exoplanet science and observing capabilities in recent years. Space agencies, both public and private, may be particularly interested in learning about the community’s views as to the optimal methods for future TS searches with current or forthcoming technology.

arxiv-2103-09055.title: OmniFair: A Declarative System for Model-Agnostic Group Fairness in Machine Learning
arxiv-2103-09055.creator: Hantian Zhang, Xu Chu, Abolfazl Asudeh, Shamkant B. Navathe
arxiv-2103-09055.description: Abstract . Machine learning (ML) is increasingly being used to make decisions in our society. ML models, however, can be unfair to certain demographic groups (e.g., African Americans or females) according to various fairness metrics. Existing techniques for producing fair ML models either are limited to the type of fairness constraints they can handle (e.g.

arxiv-2112-11272.title: X-ray timing and spectral variability properties of blazars S5 0716+714, OJ 287, Mrk 501, and RBS 2070 2021 X-ray timing and spectral variability properties of blazars S5 0716+714, OJ 287, Mrk 501, and RBS 2070 – 8
arxiv-2112-11272.creator: Maksym Mohorian, Gopal Bhatta, Tek P. Adhikari, Niraj Dhital, Radim Pánis, Adithiya Dinesh, Suvas C. Chaudhary, Rajesh K. Bachchan, Zdeněk Stuchlík
arxiv-2112-11272.description: Abstract The X-ray emission from blazars has been widely investigated using several space telescopes. In this work, we explored statistical properties of the X-ray variability in the blazars S5 0716+714, OJ 287, Mkn 501 and RBS 2070 using the archival observations from the XMM-Newton telescope between the period 2002–2020.

arxiv-2203-14357.description: Abstract . Let n ∈ ℕ n\in\mathbb{N} and let K K be a field with a henselian discrete valuation of rank n n with hereditarily euclidean residue field. Let F / K F/K be a function field in one variable in one variable. It is known that every sum of squares is a sum of 3 3 squares.

Corresponding author: Zhipeng Gao (e-mail: gaozhipeng@bupt.edu.cn). Yijing Lin and Zhipeng Gao are with the Stat
arxiv-2305-11911.creator: Yijing Lin, Zhipeng Gao, Hongyang Du, Dusit Niyato
arxiv-2305-11911.description: Abstract As the Metaverse continues to grow, the need for efficient communication and intelligent content generation becomes increasingly important. Semantic communication focuses on conveying meaning and understanding from user inputs, while AI-Generated Content utilizes artificial intelligence to create digital content and experiences.

arxiv-2306-09841.title: Are Large Language Models Really Good Logical Reasoners? A Comprehensive Evaluation and Beyond Thanks: Fangzhi Xu, Qika Lin, Jiawei Han and Tianzhe Zhao are with the School of Computer Science and Technology, Xi’an Jiaotong University, Xi’an, Shaanxi 710049, China (email: {Leo981106, tara1208260223}
arxiv-2306-09841.creator: Fangzhi Xu*, Qika Lin*, Jiawei Han, Tianzhe Zhao
arxiv-2306-09841.description: Abstract Logical reasoning consistently plays a fundamental and significant role in the domains of knowledge engineering and artificial intelligence. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a noteworthy innovation in natural language processing (NLP). However, the question of whether LLMs can effectively address the task of logical reasoning, which requires gradual cognitive inference similar to human intelligence, remains unanswered.

arxiv-2311-01966.title: Depth-guided Free-space Segmentation for a Mobile Robot
arxiv-2311-01966.creator: Christos Sevastopoulos, Joey Hussain, Stasinos Konstantopoulos, Vangelis Karkaletsis, Fillia Makedon
arxiv-2311-01966.description: Abstract Accurate indoor free-space segmentation is a challenging task due to the complexity and the dynamic nature that indoor environments exhibit. We propose an indoors free-space segmentation method that associates large depth values with navigable regions. Our method leverages an unsupervised masking technique that, using positive instances, generates segmentation labels based on textural homogeneity and depth uniformity.

arxiv-2402-11436.title: Pride and Prejudice: LLM Amplifies Self-Bias in Self-Refinement
arxiv-2402-11436.creator: Wenda Xu, Guanglei Zhu, Xuandong Zhao, Liangming Pan, Lei Li, William Yang Wang
arxiv-2402-11436.description: Abstract Recent studies show that large language models (LLMs) improve their performance through self-feedback on certain tasks while degrade on others. We discovered that such a contrary is due to LLM’s bias in evaluating their own output. In this paper, we formally define LLM’s self-bias – the tendency to favor its own generation – using two statistics.

arxiv-2402-16499.title: LLMArena : Assessing Capabilities of Large Language Models in Dynamic Multi-Agent Environments
arxiv-2402-16499.creator: Junzhe Chen, Xuming Hu, Shuodi Liu, Shiyu Huang, Wei-Wei Tu, Zhaofeng He, Lijie Wen
arxiv-2402-16499.description: Abstract Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have revealed their potential for achieving autonomous agents possessing human-level intelligence. However, existing benchmarks for evaluating LLM Agents either use static datasets, potentially leading to data leakage, or focus only on single-agent scenarios, overlooking the complexities of multi-agent interactions.

arxiv-2503-08852.title: Hydrodynamics in a villi-patterned channel due to pendular-wave activity
arxiv-2503-08852.creator: Rohan Vernekar 1, Faisal Ahmad 1, 3, Martin Garic 2, Dácil Idaira Yánez Martín 1, 3, Claude Loverdo 2, Stéphane Tanguy 3, Clément de Loubens 1
arxiv-2503-08852.description: Abstract Inspired by small intestine motility, we investigate the flow induced by a propagating pendular-wave along the walls of a channel lined with rigid, villi-like microstructures. The villi undergo harmonic axial oscillations with a phase lag relative to their neighbours, generating travelling patterns of intervillous contraction.

arxiv-2508-03818.title: Mechanism Design for Facility Location using Predictions
arxiv-2508-03818.creator: Toby Walsh
arxiv-2508-03818.description: Abstract We study mechanisms for the facility location problem augmented with predictions of the optimal facility location. We demonstrate that an egalitarian viewpoint which considers both the maximum distance of any agent from the facility and the minimum utility of any agent provides important new insights compared to a viewpoint that just considers the maximum distance.

arxiv-2601-02499.title: Polynomial Convergence of Riemannian Diffusion Models
arxiv-2601-02499.creator: Xingyu Xu, Ziyi Zhang, Yorie Nakahira, Guannan Qu, Yuejie Chi
arxiv-2601-02499.description: Abstract Diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable empirical success in the recent years and are considered one of the state-of-the-art generative models in modern AI. These models consist of a forward process, which gradually diffuses the data distribution to a noise distribution spanning the whole space, and a backward process, which inverts this transformation to recover the data distribution from noise.

arxiv-2602-08542.title: Incremental ( k , z ) (k,z) -Clustering on Graphs
arxiv-2602-08542.creator: Emilio Cruciani, Sebastian Forster, Antonis Skarlatos

arxiv-2602-14136.title: Comparative Evaluation of SDP, SOCP, and QC Convex Relaxations for Large-Scale Market-Based AC Optimal Power Flow
arxiv-2602-14136.creator: Ata Keskin
arxiv-2602-14136.description: Abstract The alternating current optimal power flow (ACOPF) problem is central to modern power system operations, determining how electricity is generated and transmitted to maximize social welfare while respecting physical and operational constraints. However, the nonlinear and non-convex nature of AC power flow equations makes finding globally optimal solutions computationally intractable for large networks.

plos-pone-0001934.description: PLOS ONE research article. Current recommendations to prevent malaria in African pregnant women rely on insecticide treated nets (ITNs) and intermittent preventive treatment (IPTp). However, there is no information on the safety and efficacy of their combined use. 1030 pregnant Mozambican women of all grav

pmc-11429410.title: Cardiovascular Risk Factors in Socioeconomically Disadvantaged Populations in a Suburb of the Largest City in Western Romania
pmc-11429410.creator: Andreea Dumitrescu, Gabriela Mut Vitcu, Svetlana Stoica, Septimiu Radu Susa, Emil Robert Stoicescu, Serafino Fazio
pmc-11429410.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background and Objectives: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) remains a major public health issue worldwide, disproportionately affecting socioeconomically disadvantaged populations due to the social determinants of health (SDOHs). In Western Romania, these populations are particularly vulnerable to CVD. This study aims to investigate the prevalence and impact of cardiovascular risk factors (CVRFs) among socioeconomically disadvantaged individuals in Western Romania and identify the primary CVRFs contributing to the high incidence of CVD within this population.

pmc-11506256.title: Blind Separation of Skin Chromophores from Multispectral Dermatological Images
pmc-11506256.creator: Mustapha Zokay, Hicham Saylani, Arvind Mukundan
pmc-11506256.description: Background/Objectives: Based on Blind Source Separation and the use of multispectral imaging, the new approach we propose in this paper aims to improve the estimation of the concentrations of the main skin chromophores (melanin, oxyhemoglobin and deoxyhemoglobin), while considering shading as a fully-fledged source.

pmc-11672629.title: The Combined Use of Triamcinolone and Platelet-Rich Plasma in Equine Metacarpophalangeal Joint Osteoarthritis Treatments: An In Vivo and In Vitro Study
pmc-11672629.creator: Kübra Guidoni, Elisabetta Chiaradia, Marco Pepe, Antonio Di Meo, Alessia Tognoloni, Matteo Seccaroni, Francesca Beccati
pmc-11672629.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryOsteoarthritis is a common joint condition in horses that is managed mainly with intraarticular treatments. While corticosteroids, such as triamcinolone acetonide, are still commonly used, regenerative treatments, such as platelet-rich plasma, have gained more attention in research studies. The aim of this study was to assess the efficiency of triamcinolone acetonide in combination with platelet-rich plasma in treating osteoarthritis in racehorses.

pmc-12454040.title: Early heart rate predicts 3-month outcomes in acute ischemic stroke patients receiving intravenous thrombolysis: a machine learning approach
pmc-12454040.creator: Mian-Xuan Yao, Min-Yi Yao, Jia Gu, Ting Gao, Yi-Mian Yuan, Yang-Kun Chen, Yong-Lin Liu
pmc-12454040.description: BackgroundThe predictive role of early heart rate (HR) dynamics in acute ischemic stroke patients (AIS) receiving intravenous thrombolysis (IVT) remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate whether HR variability within 24 h post-IVT predicts early neurological deterioration (END) and 3-month functional outcomes using machine learning.

pmc-12610433.title: Therapeutic and Clinical Potential of Adipose-Derived Stem Cell Secretome for Skin Regeneration
pmc-12610433.creator: Anna Sendera, Hubert Kubis, Anna Pałka, Agnieszka Banaś-Ząbczyk
pmc-12610433.description: Adipose-derived stem cells (AT-MSCs) exhibit great potential for application in stem cell therapy, primarily due to their unique pro-regenerative capabilities, which include supporting skin regeneration. AT-MSCs secrete a variety of biomolecules with immunomodulatory, re-epithelializing, antifibrotic, antiapoptotic, proangiogenic, and neurotrophic activity as well as the ability to promote proliferation and migration of skin cells.

pmc-12746734.title: Correlation Between Triglyceride-Glucose Index (TyG Index), Monocyte to High-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol Ratio (MHR), and the Severity of Coronary Artery Disease
pmc-12746734.creator: Di Wu, Chang Liu, Jidong Zhang, Mengjun Ge, Beibei Gao, Chunqing Wang
pmc-12746734.description: ObjectiveTo explore the relationship between the triglyceride-glucose index (TyG), the monocyte to high-density lipoprotein cholesterol ratio (MHR) and the severity of coronary artery disease (CAD) under different glucose metabolism states.MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted on 526 patients who underwent coronary angiography (CAG) for the first time in the Affiliated Hospital of Xuzhou Medical University from January 2024 to January 2025.

pmc-12972609.title: Impact of Socioeconomic Status on Dietary Intake in Adults Aged 60 and Over, in Northwestern Spain: A Study of Community‐Dwelling Older Adults Enrolled in a Municipal Active Aging Program
pmc-12972609.creator: Ana María Murillo‐Zaldívar, Rosario Alonso‐Domínguez, Jesús González‐Sánchez, Teresa Vicente‐García, José Ignacio Recio‐Rodríguez, Fausto José Barbero Iglesias, Susana González‐Manzano
pmc-12972609.description: BackgroundUnhealthy lifestyles and poor dietary habits pose a major challenge to global public health, contributing significantly to the burden of disease and mortality. This phenomenon has been connected to various sociodemographic and economic factors that negatively affect diet quality, particularly among older adults.

pmc-13033675.title: CT imaging in children with non-severe asthma and cough-variant asthma: functional spasm or structural remodeling?
pmc-13033675.creator: Li Wang, Chunying Liu, Yinghong Fan, Wanmin Xia, Cheng Xie, Yanru Liu, Pinli Zou, Qianqian Li, Tao Ai
pmc-13033675.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveTo investigate the role of CT-measured bronchial wall thickness and area in detecting airway remodeling in children with non-severe asthma and cough-variant asthma.MethodsA retrospective review was conducted on 140 children who were assigned to the non-severe asthma (AS, n = 51), cough-variant asthma (CVA, n = 50) and control (CTL, n = 39) groups at Chengdu Women’s and Children’s Central Hospital from January 2023 to June 2025.

pmc-13119553.title: AI-Based Predictive Modelling and Alert Framework for Mortality Risk and Cost–Benefit Analysis in Rabbit Production
pmc-13119553.creator: Szilveszter Csorba, Erika Országh, Ákos Józwiák, Zoltán Német, Miklós Süth, Andrea Zentai, Zsuzsa Farkas
pmc-13119553.description: Simple SummaryRabbit production systems are vulnerable to sudden increases in mortality, which can lead to significant economic losses. Early identification of elevated risk at the group level could support more timely management responses. In this study, we developed a machine learning–based framework to predict mortality risk at future observation points using routinely collected farm data.

pmc-13548788.title: Effect of sample storage on pH-value in equine faeces
pmc-13548788.creator: Katrin Madelene Lindroth, Cecilia Elisabeth Müller
pmc-13548788.description: Measurements of pH-value in equine faeces are often performed in studies on nutrition and health in horses, but a standard protocol for it is lacking despite the knowledge that different sample handling may affect the pH-value. Sample handling prior to pH-measurement is often determined by practical settings and has been reported to vary in published studies within the area.

pmc-13572684.title: Adaptive teaching, self-regulated learning and mathematics learning outcomes: a social cognitive model of learner agency in vocational education
pmc-13572684.creator: Shiqin Peng, Tongyao Han
pmc-13572684.description: IntroductionThis study examined the associations among adaptive teaching practices, self-regulated learning (SRL), and mathematics learning outcomes in vocational education, with SRL conceptualized as a form of learner agency within Zimmerman's social-cognitive model of self-regulated learning.MethodsA quantitative cross-sectional design was used with questionnaire data from 350 vocational education students enrolled in mathematics-related courses.

pmc-13597555.creator: Natalia Kelsch, Claudia Winklmair, Henning Stolze, Hans-Peter Thomas
pmc-13597555.description: HintergrundDelir ist ein häufiges neuropsychiatrisches Störungsbild, insbesondere bei älteren hospitalisierten und schwer kranken Patient:innen, mit negativen Folgen wie erhöhter Sterblichkeit und Morbidität. Bei steigendem Altersdurchschnitt der Bevölkerung ist mit einer Zunahme der Delirfälle zu rechnen, was die Notwendigkeit einer standardisierten stationären Delirversorgung weiter erhöht. Bislang ist die Umsetzung eines strukturierten Delirmanagements im stationären Setting jedoch unzureichend untersucht.
